provider: Apple Managed Apple Account (Apple School Manager), 200 GB

free_tier.stated: 200 GB of free iCloud storage for each Managed Apple Account

retention.stated: The account is owned and controlled by a school or district; no page read states what happens to the account or its storage when a student leaves

egress.terms: Normal iCloud egress, with no metering on download

tooling: none documented on the pages read: iCloud for Windows does not support Managed Apple Accounts
chaining: 200 GB times N accounts, where every account needs a school. Since no programmatic read path exists, the capacity cannot enter any programmatic stack

limits.value: enrolment in Apple School Manager is a prerequisite for every account

identity_cost.detail: an institution: Apple School Manager lets schools create and manage Managed Apple Accounts

reliability_note: The account is owned by the institution, so the bytes are not yours and do not survive leaving it. 200 GB is also below a 500 GB threshold unless multiplied, and no API exists to multiply it with

notes: A faculty member could obtain this; an individual registrant cannot, and even with a school the bytes are not portable. Recorded because it is the clearest example in the survey of capacity that exists and is unreachable for a reason that has nothing to do with the quota.
